project.title: Vampire: The Masquerade Character Creator
project.summary: A browser-based Vampire: The Masquerade V5 creator for the named Core clans, Caitiff, and Thin-bloods, with a live rules ledger, local drafts, and printable sheets.

items.title: Add an opt-in Player’s Guide source pack
items.notes: Start with a documented set of Player’s Guide options and the prerequisites, grants, and choices required to finish those builds. Tag each option with its source and preserve Core-only results. Verify a mixed-source fixture and show unavailable sources in backup and build-link previews.

items.title: Add a post-creation XP advancement journal
items.notes: Start from a finished character and track earned XP, ordered purchases, and remaining XP separately from starting allocations. Verify dependent purchases, undo or removal, reload, and a backup round-trip with a hand-checked advancement fixture.
